sql: SELECT "Bookings"."booking_id" AS k, (CAST("Bookings"."amount_of_refund" AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_payable") AS m1 FROM "Bookings" WHERE (CAST("Bookings"."amount_of_refund" AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_payable") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
